title: Network-based analysis of crucial genes for salt tolerance in rice.
authors: Li, Lulu; Yang, Long; Nie, Yamin; Zhu, Xueai; Liu, Yujie; Ding, Dan; Li, Jianbo; Wei, Xianglei; Xia, Yiming; Qiao, Weihua; Huang, Ji
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过时间序列表达和机器学习构建水稻耐盐基因调控网络，虽涉及TF-靶标互作，但核心是基因表达网络而非蛋白质-DNA三维互作建模，方法上仅用共表达和统计模型，缺乏AI/物理模拟深度，与TF-DNA结合机制研究关联较弱。
abstract: Rice responds to salt stress by modulating a vast array of genes integrated into a sophisticated regulatory network. This complexity makes it challenging to identify the key genes and the specific alleles that confer tolerance. We used time-course expression analysis to profile gene and miRNA expression associated with salt tolerance in Pokkali, a salt-tolerant rice variety. We established a framework for studying transcription factor (TF)-target (mRNA/miRNA) interactions using gene co-expression and machine learning models. Moreover, we developed a hypergeometric distribution-based method to elucidate the interactions of salt stress-related miRNA-targets. Using these approaches, we established gene co-expression networks (GCNs) and gene regulatory networks (GRNs) based on co-expression and TF/miRNA-target interactions. Hub genes with high connectivity in our networks were enriched for previously reported salt tolerance genes, a finding largely supported by subsequent haplotype analysis of 374 rice accessions. Finally, we functionally validated 3 crucial hub genes, OsCAF1B, OsADR3, and Ospdr9, by demonstrating their roles in salt tolerance using their knockout mutants. The crucial genes, haplotypes, and networks for salt tolerance identified in this study (resource available at https://cbi.njau.edu.cn/RiceSALTnet) provide a foundation for breeding rice cultivars with enhanced salt tolerance.
abstract_zh: 水稻通过调控大量基因并整合进一个复杂的调控网络来响应盐胁迫。这种复杂性使得识别赋予耐盐性的关键基因和特定等位基因变得具有挑战性。我们利用时间序列表达分析，对耐盐水稻品种Pokkali中与耐盐性相关的基因和miRNA表达进行了谱系分析。我们建立了一个框架，用于研究转录因子（TF）-靶标（mRNA/miRNA）相互作用，该框架基于基因共表达和机器学习模型。此外，我们开发了一种基于超几何分布的方法，以阐明盐胁迫相关miRNA-靶标的相互作用。利用这些方法，我们基于共表达和TF/miRNA-靶标相互作用构建了基因共表达网络（GCNs）和基因调控网络（GRNs）。我们网络中具有高连接性的枢纽基因富集了先前报道的耐盐基因，这一发现随后通过对374个水稻品种的单倍型分析得到了广泛支持。最后，我们通过敲除突变体功能验证了3个关键枢纽基因OsCAF1B、OsADR3和Ospdr9在耐盐性中的作用。本研究鉴定的耐盐关键基因、单倍型和网络（资源可在https://cbi.njau.edu.cn/RiceSALTnet获取）为培育耐盐性增强的水稻品种奠定了基础。
